title: Quick Garden Omelette
description: A quick omelette with potatoes, mushrooms, spinach, and cheese, designed for high protein and performance nutrition.

ingredients.name: potato or yam
ingredients.preparation: sliced into thin wedges, then coarsely chopped

ingredients.name: eggs (2 yolk and 4 whites)
ingredients.preparation: separate 2 of the 4 yolks and discard

ingredients.name: goat cheese (feta or cheddar work great too)

instructions.text: Pan: Heat pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil, heat then add potatoes. Sauté 10 min. stirring occasionally.
Stir in mushrooms and sauté 8 min. or until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally. Remove from pan and set aside.
Pan: Wipe pan clean with paper towels. Spray with cooking oil if needed and heat to medium high heat.

Bowl: Combine eggs, a couple of shakes of salt and pepper in a bowl and whisk until eggs are frothy. Pour mixture into pan, and stir briskly with a heatproof spatula or wooden spoon until egg starts to thicken (~ 20 sec.).
Arrange half of potato mixture, 1 cup spinach, and 2 tbsp cheese over omelet.
Run spatula around edges and under omelet to loosen it from pan. Fold omelet in half and continue heating until all egg is cooked. Slide omelet onto a plate. Cut in half crosswise and enjoy.
